_comment: Hosting serves the same config.json the app ships with, so the bundled and served copies cannot drift. Data/build.py stages the COMPLETE site into _hosting before deploying — a Hosting deploy replaces the whole site, so anything missing from the staged directory is deleted from the live site.

headers._comment: The index that names every pack. Must not be cached hard, or clients keep resolving content against a stale list and never see anything new.

Content-addressed payloads (name-<sha8>.zip): a given URL's bytes never change, and new content gets a new filename. That is why these can be immutable — the cache is never wrong, and old installs keep resolving the old URL until they refresh the manifest.
